description: Admin Dark Mode, Toast Notifications & Post-Action Navigation - Improve admin panel UX with OS-aware dark mode toggle, sonner toast feedback on all CRUD operations, and automatic navigation after post saves.

userStories.title: Install and configure sonner toast library
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a toast notification provider installed so that all admin pages can fire toasts.
acceptanceCriteria: sonner is added to frontend/package.json dependencies
<Toaster /> is rendered inside the admin CMS layout (app/admin/(cms)/layout.tsx)
Toaster is positioned bottom-right with 4-second default duration
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Install and configure next-themes for dark mode
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a theme provider set up so dark mode can be toggled and persisted in the admin panel.
acceptanceCriteria: next-themes is added to frontend/package.json dependencies
A ThemeProvider wraps the admin root layout (app/admin/layout.tsx) with attribute="class" and defaultTheme="system"
suppressHydrationWarning prop is added to the <html> tag in the root layout (app/layout.tsx)
Tailwind CSS v4 dark mode is configured via @variant dark (.dark) in globals.css or existing config confirmed to handle it
globals.css has both :root and .dark CSS variable token definitions for shadcn components
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add dark mode toggle to admin sidebar and mobile nav
userStories.description: As an admin user, I want a dark/light mode toggle in the navigation so I can override the OS preference when needed.
acceptanceCriteria: A sun/moon icon toggle button is visible in the admin sidebar (desktop) above the Logout button
A sun/moon icon toggle button is visible in the mobile top nav
Clicking the toggle switches between light and dark mode immediately
The preference persists across page refreshes (stored by next-themes in localStorage)
Sun icon shown for light mode, Moon icon shown for dark mode
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Apply dark mode styles to admin layout and navigation
userStories.description: As an admin user, I want the admin sidebar, header, and navigation to look correct in dark mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar background, text, border, and active-link highlight all have dark mode variants
Mobile top nav has dark mode variants
No elements remain hard-coded to white/light backgrounds in the layout/nav components
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Apply dark mode styles to admin content pages
userStories.description: As an admin user, I want all admin CMS pages to look correct in dark mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard page has dark mode variants
About edit page (form inputs, cards, labels) has dark mode variants
Resume edit page (experience cards, inputs, collapsible sections) has dark mode variants
Posts list page (table/cards, action buttons) has dark mode variants
Post new page has dark mode variants
Post edit (/admin/posts/[id]) page has dark mode variants
Form inputs (text, textarea, select) use consistent dark-mode-aware border and background
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Toast notifications on About page save
userStories.description: As an admin user, I want to see a toast message when I save About page data so I know whether it succeeded or failed.
acceptanceCriteria: On successful save of any About section: a success toast appears with message 'About saved successfully'
On failed save: an error toast appears with message 'Failed to save about. Please try again.'
Existing inline success/error alert divs on the About page are removed and replaced by toasts
The save button returns to its default state after operation completes (success or failure)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Toast notifications on Resume page save
userStories.description: As an admin user, I want to see a toast message when I save Resume data so I know whether it succeeded or failed.
acceptanceCriteria: On successful save of any Resume section or experience item: a success toast appears with message 'Resume saved successfully'
On failed save: an error toast appears with message 'Failed to save resume. Please try again.'
Existing inline success/error divs on the Resume page are removed and replaced by toasts
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Toast notifications on Posts CRUD
userStories.description: As an admin user, I want toast messages when I create, update, or delete a post so I always know the outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: On successful post creation: success toast 'Post created successfully'
On successful post update: success toast 'Post updated successfully'
On successful post delete: success toast 'Post deleted successfully'
On any failed operation: error toast with descriptive message
Existing inline success/error divs on all Posts pages are removed and replaced by toasts
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Redirect to post list after successful post create or edit
userStories.description: As an admin user, I want to be sent back to the posts list after saving a new or existing post so I can see the updated list immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: After successful create on /admin/posts/new: fires success toast then redirects to /admin/posts
After successful save on /admin/posts/[id]: fires success toast then redirects to /admin/posts
Redirect happens after the toast is triggered so the toast is visible on the posts list page
On failure: no redirect occurs, error toast shown and user stays on the form
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Exit edit mode after successful inline save (About & Resume)
userStories.description: As an admin user, I want inline edit sections to collapse back to read-only view after a successful save so I get clear confirmation that saving is done.
acceptanceCriteria: About page: after a successful save, the edited section transitions back to its read-only/display state
Resume page: after a successful save of an experience item, that item collapses back to its collapsed/read-only state
On failure: the section stays in edit mode so the user can correct and retry
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
